projectDescription: A web-based party game referee that uses voice announcements and optional camera tracking to run The Floor is Lava rounds for 2–8 players.
keyFeatures: Spanish voice announcer with selectable TTS voice
7 game objectives including cup grab, hot potato, scavenger hunt, and survival
8 difficulty paces from Siesta (gentle) to Caos (brutal)
Optional camera tracking detects player colors, cup grabs, and lava floor violations
Pre-lava warning announcements and fake-out phases (Traición mode)
Works offline as a standalone HTML file
publicApiSurface: Setup screen: player names, color swatches, objective selector, difficulty selector, duration selector
Voice selector: Spanish TTS voice chooser with test button
Camera calibration: 4-step flow (frame room → mark safe zones → register player colors → register cup)
Play screen: phase display (safe / warn / fake / lava), countdown clock, action buttons, player chips
Burn player: tap a player chip to deduct a life during lava phase
Undo burn: revert the last life deduction
Pause/resume: freeze the round timer and voice
End round: show results, leaderboard, next round or finish game
Objectives: copa, vuelta, cacería, papa, estatuas, cadena, supervivencia
Difficulty paces: siesta, fácil, normal, metrónomo, volcán, marea, traición, caos
